reasons: All cited text files re-hashed (sha256 equals text_sha256) and every quote equals text[char_start:char_end], occurring once. claim_gate.validate_claim returns no errors. Identity: EO 10826 (Eisenhower, June 25, 1959, 24 FR 5233), Authorizing the Civil Service Commission To Confer Benefits in Certain Cases. The single clause covers sections 1-3; the revocation of EO 10535 in section 3 is correctly described as a one-time command complete on issuance, and the continuing authority in sections 1-2 carries the operative state. The OFR note 'Amended by: EO 12107, December 28, 1978' is quoted verbatim; EO 12107 section 2-101(b) lists 10826 and substitutes the Office of Personnel Management for the Civil Service Commission, effective January 1, 1979 by section 2-404, as the later event states. Current 5 CFR 351.502 still refers to cases under the order pending resolution by OPM, and the search counts match the current-law output. Minor imprecision: the rationale presents section 2 of the Civil Service Act together with R.S. 1753 as the derivation of 5 U.S.C. 3301, whose held derivation lists only R.S. 1753 / 5 U.S.C. 631; this does not affect the predicate. No later revocation found. Operative on 2026-10-14.
